prompt.text:
Implement pure operations for a journal timeline.

Export exactly `{ buildTimeline, deleteEntry, edgeIndex }` using `module.exports`.

Every entry must be `{ id, date, time, text, city, image }`: `id`, `text`, and `city` are strings with non-empty IDs; `date` is a real `YYYY-MM-DD` date; `time` is valid 24-hour `HH:MM`; and `image` is either `null` or a string. IDs must be unique.

`buildTimeline(entries, dateQuery)` validates all entries. `dateQuery` must be `null` or a valid date. Filter by exact date when non-null, then return detached entry copies ordered newest date/time first. Entries with identical date and time retain their original relative order. Empty input returns an empty array.

`deleteEntry(entries, id)` validates the entries and requires a string ID. Return detached copies excluding every matching ID; an absent ID changes only object identity, not content or order.

`edgeIndex(entries, edge)` validates entries in their supplied order. Return `-1` for an empty array, otherwise `0` for `"top"` and `entries.length - 1` for `"bottom"`. Reject other edges with `TypeError`.

None of the functions may mutate or alias input entries.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
